why_ai: Drivers hook and haul vehicles on roadsides at all hours; no software moves a car.

why_digital: Physical vehicles moved from local roadsides by trucks dispatched over phone and radio.

why_clarity: Every call needs the same intake, truck match and ETA, checked by arrival time.
why_digital: Phone calls in, truck assignments and ETA messages out, handled remotely.
